The setup here is clever, short enough that it doesn't outstay its welcome and amusing. The song is a minor earworm, I hummed it over my 2 am taco dinner, but it really did not need to be five minutes long :P

I would look into getting a better recording setup if you plan on doing more musical works in the future, what you have works here in context but you'll need a more professional level of quality if you make audio content a habit, which I hope you do!

item.content:encoded:
part 3 of toejamcon. jamcon was a blast and i loved every second of it but i have regrets. namely winning the tarantino. but i also got the cicierega so…it evens out?

thanks to GerrymanderedBassist for look at the lyrics to this when i was still in the middle of writing, and a few other people for checking out the lyrics and the song, and to everyone who helped with the file size discussion. im so glad i was able to make more music for this site. hopefully in the future ill be able to make more.

Edit: WE DID IT GIRLS, GAYS, AND ENBIES, WE’RE FEATURED, AND I COULD NOT BE MORE BLINDSIDED, HUMORED, AND HONORED BY THIS. toejamcon4ever

Edit 2: HOLY SHIT WE PASSED +100!!!! i cant believe a song about toes was favorably rated by over 100 people, thank you so much.
